source_refs.note: Exercise 4.2, Question 5: Find values of x, parts (i)-(iii) (book page 60).

blocks.prompt: 5 (i) Find values of \(x\) if: \(\begin{vmatrix} 3 & 1 & x \\ -1 & -3 & -4 \\ x & 1 & 0 \end{vmatrix} = -30\)
blocks.explanation:
Is determinant ke andar \(x\) hai. Expand karein to \(x\) ki quadratic expression banegi.
Phir usay \(-30\) ke barabar rakh kar equation solve karni hai.
Plan: row 1 ke along expand, simplify, solve; discriminant check karein.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\begin{vmatrix} 3 & 1 & x \\ -1 & -3 & -4 \\ x & 1 & 0 \end{vmatrix} = -30\)
Humein find karna hai: \(x\) ki values.
Tareeqa: Row 1 ke along expansion (signs \(+,\,-,\,+\)) se \(ax^2 + bx + c\) milega; phir quadratic equation hal karenge. \(x\) ko bilkul ek number ki tarah treat karein.

Row 1 ke minors
\[M_{11} = (-3)(0) - (-4)(1) = 4\]
\[M_{12} = (-1)(0) - (-4)(x) = 4x\]
\[M_{13} = (-1)(1) - (-3)(x) = 3x - 1\]
Kyun: Row 1 aur ek ek column chhupa kar \(2 \times 2\) rule lagaya. Minus ke saath negative number plus ban jata hai.

Expand karein
\[\Delta = 3(4) - 1(4x) + x(3x - 1)\]
\[= 12 - 4x + 3x^2 - x\]
\[= 3x^2 - 5x + 12\]
Kyun: Entries \(3, 1, x\) ko signs \(+,\,-,\,+\) ke saath minors se multiply kiya, phir like terms jama kiye: \(-4x - x = -5x\).

Equation banayein
\[3x^2 - 5x + 12 = -30\]
\[3x^2 - 5x + 42 = 0\]
Kyun: Dono taraf 30 jama kiya taake right side zero ho jaye; quadratic hamesha is shakal mein hal hoti hai.

Discriminant
\[b^2 - 4ac = 25 - 4(3)(42)\]
\[= 25 - 504 = -479 < 0\]
Kyun: \(a = 3,\ b = -5,\ c = 42\). Discriminant negative ho to koi real root nahi hota, kyunke negative ka real square root nahi hota.

Roots (complex)
\[x = \dfrac{5 \pm \sqrt{-479}}{6}\]
\[= \dfrac{5 \pm i\sqrt{479}}{6}\]
Kyun: Quadratic formula \(x = \frac{-b \pm \sqrt{b^2 - 4ac}}{2a}\). Unit 1 mein humne seekha tha ke \(\sqrt{-479} = i\sqrt{479}\); is liye complex roots milte hain.
Dhyan dein: Exam mein agar answer key se jawab na mile to ghabrayein nahi; apni expansion dobara check karein, aur sahi hai to wohi likhein.
blocks.final_answer: Jaisa sawal chhapa hai, \(x\) ki koi real value nahi; roots \(x = \frac{5 \pm i\sqrt{479}}{6}\) hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key mein \(x = 2\) ya \(-1\) likha hai, lekin yeh chhape hue sawal par poora nahi utarta. Determinant \(3x^2 - 5x + 12\) ke barabar hai: \(x = 2\) par yeh 14 aur \(x = -1\) par 20 banta hai, \(-30\) kabhi nahi. Matlab sawal (kisi entry ya right side) mein misprint hai. Chhape hue sawal ke mutabiq \(3x^2 - 5x + 42 = 0\) ka koi real root nahi; roots \(\frac{5 \pm i\sqrt{479}}{6}\) hain.

blocks.prompt: 5 (ii) Find values of \(x\) if: \(\begin{vmatrix} 1 & x-1 & 3 \\ -1 & x+1 & 2 \\ 2 & -3 & x \end{vmatrix} = 0\)
blocks.explanation:
Phir \(x\) wala determinant hai jo zero ke barabar hona chahiye.
Plan: row 1 ke along expand, terms ko quadratic mein jama karein, phir solve.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\begin{vmatrix} 1 & x-1 & 3 \\ -1 & x+1 & 2 \\ 2 & -3 & x \end{vmatrix} = 0\)
Humein find karna hai: \(x\) ki values.
Tareeqa: Row 1 ke along expansion, phir quadratic formula. Is mein \(x - 1\) aur \(x + 1\) jaise brackets hain, inhein hamesha bracket mein rakh kar multiply karein.

Row 1 ke minors
\[M_{11} = (x+1)(x) - (2)(-3) = x^2 + x + 6\]
\[M_{12} = (-1)(x) - (2)(2) = -x - 4\]
\[M_{13} = (-1)(-3) - (x+1)(2) = 1 - 2x\]
Kyun: Har minor ke liye row 1 aur us entry ka column chhupaya. \(3 - 2x - 2 = 1 - 2x\).

Expand karein
\[\Delta = 1(x^2 + x + 6) - (x-1)(-x-4) + 3(1 - 2x)\]
\[= x^2 + x + 6 + (x^2 + 3x - 4) + 3 - 6x\]
\[= 2x^2 - 2x + 5\]
Kyun: Beech wali term mein do minus hain: \(-(x-1)(-x-4) = (x-1)(x+4) = x^2 + 4x - x - 4\). Phir \(x^2\) terms, \(x\) terms aur numbers alag alag jama kiye.
Dhyan dein: Yahi wo jagah hai jahan sab se zyada sign ki ghaltiyan hoti hain.

Solve karein
\[2x^2 - 2x + 5 = 0\]
\[b^2 - 4ac = 4 - 40 = -36 < 0\]
\[x = \dfrac{2 \pm 6i}{4} = \dfrac{1 \pm 3i}{2}\]
Kyun: Discriminant negative hai, real root nahi. Quadratic formula se complex roots: \(\sqrt{-36} = 6i\), phir 2 se cut kiya.

Tasdeeq (key wali values)
\[x = 0:\ \Delta = 5,\quad x = 1:\ \Delta = 5\]
Kyun: \(2(0) - 0 + 5 = 5\) aur \(2 - 2 + 5 = 5\). Key wali values se determinant 5 banta hai, zero nahi; neeche correction dekhiye.
blocks.final_answer: Jaisa sawal chhapa hai, \(x\) ki koi real value nahi; roots \(x = \frac{1 \pm 3i}{2}\) hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key mein \(x = 0\) ya \(1\) likha hai. Yeh chhape hue sawal par fit nahi: dono values par determinant \(2x^2 - 2x + 5 = 5\) hai, zero nahi. Agar sawal mein "\(= 5\)" hota to key sahi hoti. Chhape hue sawal ke mutabiq \(2x^2 - 2x + 5 = 0\) ka koi real root nahi; roots \(\frac{1 \pm 3i}{2}\) hain.

blocks.prompt: 5 (iii) Find values of \(x\) if: \(\begin{vmatrix} 1 & 1 & 1 \\ 2 & x & 2 \\ 3 & 6 & x \end{vmatrix} = 0\)
blocks.explanation:
Determinant mein \(x\) diagonal par do dafa aata hai, aur value zero chahiye.
Row 1 hai \(1, 1, 1\); column operations se foran zeros ban jayenge, aur seedha factor shakal milegi.
Plan: \(C_2 - C_1\), \(C_3 - C_1\), phir triangular shakal se solve.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\begin{vmatrix} 1 & 1 & 1 \\ 2 & x & 2 \\ 3 & 6 & x \end{vmatrix} = 0\)
Humein find karna hai: \(x\) ki values.
Tareeqa: Property vii se row 1 mein zeros, phir triangular determinant (Property viii). Is tarah equation khud factors mein aa jati hai, alag se factorise nahi karna parta.

Row 1 mein zeros banayein
\[C_2 - C_1 \to C_2,\quad C_3 - C_1 \to C_3\]
\[\begin{vmatrix} 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 2 & x-2 & 0 \\ 3 & 3 & x-3 \end{vmatrix} = 0\]
Kyun: Row 2: \(x - 2\) aur \(2 - 2 = 0\); row 3: \(6 - 3 = 3\) aur \(x - 3\). Value nahi badli.

Triangular determinant
\[1 \cdot (x-2)(x-3) = 0\]
Kyun: Diagonal ke upar sab zero hain (lower triangular), to value diagonal ka product hai (Property viii). Chahein to row 1 ke along expand kar ke bhi yahi milta hai.

Solve karein
\[x - 2 = 0 \Rightarrow x = 2\]
\[x - 3 = 0 \Rightarrow x = 3\]
Kyun: Do cheezon ka product zero tabhi hota hai jab un mein se koi ek zero ho. Is liye har factor ko alag alag zero rakha.

Tasdeeq
\[x = 2:\ R_2 = (2, 2, 2) = 2R_1 \Rightarrow \Delta = 0\]
\[x = 3:\ C_1 = (1, 2, 3) = C_3 \Rightarrow \Delta = 0 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(x = 2\) par row 2 row 1 ki dugni hai (2 bahar nikalein to do ek jaise rows); \(x = 3\) par column 1 aur column 3 ek jaise. Dono haalaton mein determinant zero.
